expected_behavior: The default Markdown profile is readable_compact and retains the declared openai-obsidian-pack-v1.4 pack schema.
A representative compact message matches the public golden specimen exactly.
Switching between readable and readable_compact changes only the Markdown projection, not canonical evidence.
Alternate branches remain in canonical evidence and are rendered as linked review sections.
Compact evidence uses native footnotes and does not embed payload content in callouts or footnote definitions.
An exported Textdoc payload is copied, indexed, and retains verifiable content integrity.
A same-name payload diagnostic never replaces a missing canonical file identity.
Unlinked assets are not copied by default and are copied only when the explicit option is enabled.
The contract bundle is generated by the real parser and its synthetic pack validates.
